class.name: Netw
class.brief_description: Static entry points for the Networked API.
class.description: The interface provided by this class is optional and is supposed to work [u]with[/u] the default [SceneMultiplayer].

method.name: action
change_scene_to_file
method.description: Opens [param path] and moves players to it. No node moves with them, so spawn their nodes from [signal NetwSessionHandle.scene_changed]. [param scope] says who moves. On a client this is a request that [method configure_scene_requests] decides, and it is rejected when there is none. [codeblock] var err: Error = await Netw.change_scene_to_file( self, "res://match.tscn").wait() if err != OK: status.text = "Could not start the match." [/codeblock]

method.name: change_scene_to_packed
method.description: The same change as [method change_scene_to_file], from a [PackedScene] that came from a file. A [PackedScene] built in memory is rejected.

method.name: channel
method.description: A [NetwChannel] for sending raw bytes in batches. [param channel_id] runs from [code]100[/code] to [code]254[/code]. [codeblock] var voice := Netw.channel(self, 100) voice.broadcast(frame, false) [/codeblock]

method.name: claim_authority
method.description: Asks the server to make this peer the [member NetwEntity.controller] of the entity [param node] belongs to. Same as [method NetwEntity.claim_authority]. [codeblock] Netw.claim_authority(self, NetwEntity.HOLD_YIELDABLE).then(pick_up) [/codeblock] The promise fails with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] when [param node] has no entity. [b]Player request.[/b]

method.name: clock
method.description:
Returns the clock for the [member Node.multiplayer] of [param node]. [codeblock] @onready var clock := Netw.clock(self)
func _ready() -> void: clock.before_tick.connect(_sample_input) clock.on_tick.connect(_simulate) [/codeblock] [method configure_clock] is where the clock is set up before [member MultiplayerAPI.multiplayer_peer] connects.

method.name: configure_admission
method.description:
Decides whether a joining peer gets a [NetwPlayer]. [param handler] receives the peer id and the arguments of [method prepare_join]. Return [constant @GlobalScope.OK] to accept. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_admission(admit)
# the client called Netw.prepare_join(self, username) func admit(peer_id: int, username: StringName) -> Error: if nakama.username_for_peer(peer_id) != username: return ERR_UNAUTHORIZED return OK [/codeblock] To stop a peer from connecting at all, before [signal MultiplayerAPI.peer_connected], use [member NetwMultiplayer.auth_callback] as you would with [SceneMultiplayer]. [b]Server Only.[/b]

method.name: configure_clock
method.description: Sets up the clock for the [member Node.multiplayer] and returns the [NetwClockConfig] to fill in. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_clock(self) \ .ticks_per_second(60) \ .display_offset_ticks(2) [/codeblock] Pass an [annotation @GDScript.@export] [NetwClockConfig] as [param preset] to set it from the inspector, and call this from [method Node._enter_tree].

method.name: configure_database
method.description:
Declares a [NetwDatabase] named [param name] on [member Node.multiplayer] of [param node]. [codeblock] func _ready() -> void: Netw.configure_database(self, &"saves").backend(preload("res://save_backend.tres")) [/codeblock] Get it later with [method database]. Pass an [annotation @GDScript.@export] [NetwDatabaseConfig] as [param preset] to set it from the inspector. [codeblock] @export var database_config: NetwDatabaseConfig
func _enter_tree() -> void: Netw.configure_database(self, &"saves", database_config) [/codeblock]

method.name: configure_despawn
method.description: Declares what the other peers do with [param node] when [method despawn] removes it. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_despawn(self).linger(0.5) [/codeblock]

method.name: configure_entity
method.description: Returns the [NetwEntity] that represents [param node] in the [member Node.multiplayer] session. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: var entity := Netw.configure_entity(self) # the node now behaves like `Node.set_multiplayer_authority(peer_id)` entity.initial_controller = NetwEntity.INITIAL_REPRESENTED_PEER [/codeblock]

method.name: configure_interest
method.description: Declares which [NetwInterestLayer] layer [param node] belongs to, and returns the [NetwInterestHandle] that is also [member NetwEntity.interest] of that [param node]. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_interest(self) \ .join( \ &"team:red", \ NetwMultiplayer.LEAVE_POLICY_RETAIN, \ NetwMultiplayer.PERCEPTION_POLICY_HIDE, \ ) \ .join(&"sight") \ .on_enter(_on_interest_enter) [/codeblock]

method.name: configure_join
method.description:
Declares what the server does with each peer that joins. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_join(spawn_at)
func spawn_at(who: NetwPlayer, point: StringName, team: int) -> void: arena.add_child(Netw.spawn_player(who, _spawn_avatar, team)) [/codeblock] [param handler] receives the [NetwPlayer], then the arguments the client passed to [method prepare_join] after its username. The username is [member NetwPlayer.username]. [b]Server Only.[/b]

method.name: configure_lagcomp
method.description: Tunes how far back the [NetwMultiplayer] records what every node held. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_lagcomp(self).input_gate_deadline(16) [/codeblock] [param preset] works as in [method configure_clock].

method.name: configure_multiplayer_scene
method.description: Makes [param node] a multiplayer scene. Players only see its children while they are in it. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_multiplayer_scene(self).labeled(&"Arena") [/codeblock]

method.name: configure_persistence
method.description: Declares which row of which [NetwDatabase] [param node] loads and saves from. [codeblock] func _ready() -> void: Netw.configure_property(self, &"gold") \ .persisted(game.save_schema.column_ref(0)) Netw.configure_persistence(self) \ .database(&"saves") \ .schema(game.save_schema) \ .record_id(account_name) [/codeblock] See [NetwPersistenceConfig], [NetwPersistenceHandle] and [NetwDatabase].

method.name: configure_property
method.description:
Declares how [param property] is synchronized. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_property(self, &"fuel")
func refuel() -> void: fuel = 100.0 Netw.sync_property(self, &"fuel") [/codeblock] See [NetwPropertyConfig] for the options.

method.name: configure_rpc
configure_scene_requests
configure_schema
method.description:
Declares a schema for a table of records. [codeblock] class Mobs: static var schema := Netw.configure_schema(&"Mob") static var pos := schema.vector3(&"pos") static var hp := schema.u16(&"hp")
@onready var mobs := Netw.table(self, &"Mob") [/codeblock] Read and write the table with [method table].

method.name: configure_server_info
method.description:
Declares what this server says about itself when another peer probes it with [method NetwConnectHandle.endpoint_probe]. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_server_info(server_info)
func server_info(info: NetwServerInfo) -> NetwServerInfo: info.motd = "Friday night session" info.max_players = 8 return info [/codeblock]

method.name: configure_session
method.description: Configures the [member Node.multiplayer] session with settings [SceneMultiplayer] does not have. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_session(self) \ .app(&"bomber-v2") \ .role(NetwMultiplayer.ROLE_LISTEN_SERVER) [/codeblock] See [NetwSessionConfig] for the settings.

method.name: configure_signal
method.description: Registers [param sig] so [method emit_entity_signal] may emit it on every peer. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_signal(self.exploded) # only the server may emit it [/codeblock] Emitting it also fires the local listeners, as with [method NetwMemberConfig.call_local].

method.name: configure_spawn
method.description:
Registers [param callable] as a function [method spawn] may run on every peer to build the same node. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_spawn(_spawn_bullet)
func _spawn_bullet(dir: Vector2, tier: int) -> Node: var bullet := BulletScene.instantiate() bullet.setup(dir, tier) return bullet
# ...
var bullet := Netw.spawn(_spawn_bullet, dir, tier) # server only muzzle.add_child(bullet)
# clients build the same node with the same arguments, in the same place [/codeblock]

method.name: connection
database
method.description: Returns the [NetwDatabase] declared as [param name] with [method configure_database]. [codeblock] var db: NetwDatabase = Netw.database(self, &"saves") [/codeblock]

method.name: despawn
method.description: Removes the node [method spawn] or [method replicate] made, on every peer. [codeblock] Netw.despawn(bullet) [/codeblock] See [NetwDespawnOpts] for [param opts]. Returns [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] for a node that was not spawned, and [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNAVAILABLE] outside a session. A client can call it when it is the [member NetwEntity.controller] and [member NetwEntity.lifecycle] is [constant NetwEntity.LIFECYCLE_CONTROLLER]. The node is removed on that client at once, and comes back if the server refuses.

method.name: emit_entity_signal
method.description:
Emits [param sig] on every peer, including the local one, with the arguments that follow. [codeblock] signal exploded(position: Vector2)
func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_signal(self.exploded)
# ...
Netw.emit_entity_signal(self.exploded, position) [/codeblock] Do not also call [code]sig.emit()[/code], or local listeners fire twice.

method.name: of
method.description: Returns the [member Node.multiplayer] of [param node] as a [NetwMultiplayer]. [codeblock] var api := Netw.of(self) api.entity_despawn(route) [/codeblock] A node that is in no tree returns [code]null[/code].

method.name: prepare_join
method.description: Joins the game as [param username]. The arguments after [param username] are passed to the [method configure_join] handler. [codeblock] Netw.prepare_join(self, &"Dev", &"red") multiplayer.multiplayer_peer = peer [/codeblock] Call it before or after assigning [member MultiplayerAPI.multiplayer_peer]. The join can still be refused later, which emits [signal NetwConnectHandle.join_failed]. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the join will be sent ┠╴ERR_UNAVAILABLE the join could not be sent ┠╴ERR_ALREADY_IN_USE a join was already requested ┖╴ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER username is empty [/codeblock] [b]Player request.[/b]

method.name: release_authority
method.description: Gives control of the entity [param node] belongs to to [param successor], or to the server when [code]0[/code]. Same as [method NetwEntity.release_authority]. The promise fails with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] when [param node] has no entity. [b]Player request.[/b]

method.name: reload_current_scene
method.description: Reloads the scene this peer displays, like [method SceneTree.reload_current_scene].

method.name: reparent
method.description: Moves [param node] under [param new_parent] like [method Node.reparent]. The promise resolves once the server has moved it. Other peers move it after. [codeblock] await Netw.reparent(body, level2.get_node(^"Players")).wait() [/codeblock] Unlike [method Node.reparent], it does not fire [Area3D] and [Area2D] enter and exit signals during the move, which works around [url=https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/14578]this issue[/url]. Otherwise [method Node.reparent] works fine. The promise fails with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] when [param node] has no entity, and [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNAVAILABLE] outside a session. A client can call it when it is the [member NetwEntity.controller] and [member NetwEntity.lifecycle] is [constant NetwEntity.LIFECYCLE_CONTROLLER]. The node moves on that client at once, and moves back if the server refuses.

method.name: replicate
method.description: Spawns [param node] on every peer from its [member Node.scene_file_path], and returns its [NetwEntity]. Call it before adding [param node] to the tree. Peers receive it when it enters the tree, so set its starting values in between. [codeblock] var body := PlayerScene.instantiate() var entity := Netw.replicate(body, player) body.position = spawn_point scene.add_child(body) [/codeblock] A client can call it without [param owner] when [param node] sets [member NetwEntity.lifecycle] to [constant NetwEntity.LIFECYCLE_CONTROLLER]. That client becomes its [member NetwEntity.controller].

method.name: request
method.description: Calls [param callable] on the server and returns a [NetwPromise] with its return value. [codeblock] var sold: bool = await Netw.request(shop.buy, &"shield").wait() [/codeblock] The method must be an RPC, as for [method rpc].

method.name: request_all
method.description: Calls [param callable] on every peer that can see the node, and returns a [NetwGroupPromise] with each return value.

method.name: request_controller
method.description: Calls [param callable] on the peer driving the node, its [member NetwEntity.controller].

method.name: request_id
method.description: Calls [param callable] on [param peer_id] and returns a [NetwPromise] with its return value. Use [method request_all] to call every peer.

method.name: rewind
method.description: Moves every entity in [param entities] back to where it was at [param tick], calls [param body], then moves them back. Use it to check a hit where the shooter saw the target. [codeblock] func _fire(ctx: NetwActionContext) -> void: Netw.rewind(Netw.scene(self).entities, ctx.view_tick, _trace_shot) [/codeblock]

method.name: rpc
method.description: Calls [param callable] on every peer that can see the node. [codeblock] Netw.rpc(turret.aim, yaw) [/codeblock]

method.name: rpc_controller
method.description: Calls [param callable] on the peer driving the node, its [member NetwEntity.controller].

method.name: rpc_id
method.description: Calls [param callable] on [param peer_id], or on every peer when [code]0[/code].

method.name: sample
scene
method.description: Returns the multiplayer scene [param node] is in, or the one called [param named]. [codeblock] var here := Netw.scene(self) # the scene I am in var arena := Netw.scene(spawned) # the one I just spawned var track := Netw.scene(self, &"Track") # the only live Track [/codeblock]

method.name: service
method.description: Returns the service registered as [param type], or [code]null[/code]. A service is like an autoload, but one per [MultiplayerAPI]. [codeblock] var gamestate := Netw.service(self, MyGamestate) as MyGamestate [/codeblock]

method.name: service_register
method.description: Registers [param service] so [method service] returns it. [codeblock] Netw.service_register(self, MyGamestate.new()) [/codeblock] [param type] defaults to the class of [param service]. Registering another service with the same [param type] replaces it.

method.name: service_unregister
method.description: Reverses [method service_register].

method.name: session
method.description: The [NetwSessionHandle] of the [member Node.multiplayer]. Mostly useful for connecting signals. [codeblock] var s := Netw.session(self) s.entered.connect(_on_entered) s.disconnected.connect(_on_over) s.ended.connect(_on_over) [/codeblock]

method.name: spawn
method.description: Calls [param fn] with the arguments after it on every peer, and returns the node it created here. Add it to the tree yourself. [codeblock] muzzle.add_child(Netw.spawn(_spawn_bullet, dir, 2)) [/codeblock] Register [param fn] with [method configure_spawn] first, and add the node to the tree before the next tick. A client can call it when the node sets [member NetwEntity.lifecycle] to [constant NetwEntity.LIFECYCLE_CONTROLLER]. That client becomes its [member NetwEntity.controller], sees it at once, and loses it if the server refuses.

method.name: spawn_player
method.description: Like [method spawn], for the node [param player] controls. [codeblock] players.add_child( Netw.spawn_player(player, _spawn_avatar, character_class) ) [/codeblock] The node is despawned when [param player] leaves. With [method NetwPersistenceConfig.load_on_spawn], other peers receive it once its save is loaded. [b]Server Only.[/b]

method.name: sync_property
method.description: Sends the current value of [param property] to the other peers. Use it for a property that changes rarely. [codeblock] func refuel() -> void: fuel = 100.0 Netw.sync_property(self, &"fuel") [/codeblock] Call [method configure_property] first.

method.name: table

constants.constant: Every player moves to the new scene.
Every player in the requester's scene moves.
The multiplayer scene shares the physics and render world of whatever it is parented into.
The multiplayer scene has its own world in a [SubViewport], so it never collides with another scene.
